row.title: Tenant checks read progress.json, not the tenant registry, so a live tenant escaped all of them (ADMIT-1)
row.body: Replication Ledger was live with a worker, a beat clock and a showcase but had no progress row, so progress, tenantpromo, fullstack and stickiness never looked at it. Fix: foundation/admit.py derives every registry row from the doctrine/tenant-repos.json row; admit --check in checks, admit --apply in regen_generated. Also: the front door's first build failed whenever the AI allowance was in crawl mode (LAUNCH-PATH-1 probe red); site/worker.js builds a no-model draft. org-settings was red only on archived repos; apprepos.js skips archived and not-yet-created repos. D1 size had no guard; M-storage liveness metric in every seed.
